skills.name: api-design
skills.description: Design clean REST or GraphQL APIs with consistent resource modeling, errors, pagination, and versioning. Use when adding or revising HTTP APIs.

skills.name: changelog
skills.description: Maintain Keep-a-Changelog and semver-oriented CHANGELOG entries from git history. Use when preparing versions or backfilling history.

skills.name: code-explain
skills.description: Explain complex code paths in plain language with structure, invariants, and diagrams when useful. Use for onboarding, reviews, or understanding legacy code.

skills.name: commit
skills.description: Write conventional, high-signal git commit messages from a staged diff. Use when the user asks to commit, draft a commit message, or summarize changes.

skills.name: debug
skills.description: Systematic debugging to reproduce, isolate, hypothesize, fix, and verify failures. Use for bugs, flaky tests, crashes, and unexpected behavior.

skills.name: dependency-audit
skills.description: Review dependencies for security risk, bloat, license issues, and upgrade strategy. Use when adding packages or doing periodic audits.

skills.name: docs-writer
skills.description: Turn messy notes or repos into crisp README and docs with problem statement, quickstart, examples, and pitfalls. Use when writing or rewriting documentation.

skills.name: incident-response
skills.description: Run an engineering incident from triage through mitigation, communication, and postmortem. Use during outages or severe production defects.

skills.name: performance
skills.description: Profile and optimize hot paths with measurements first. Use for latency, CPU, memory, or database slowdowns.

skills.name: pr-review
skills.description: Structured pull-request review covering correctness, security, tests, API design, and clarity. Use when reviewing diffs, PRs, or pre-merge changes.

skills.name: prompt-engineer
skills.description: Craft robust system and user prompts, tool instructions, and lightweight evals for LLM features. Use when building AI products or agent behaviors.

skills.name: refactor
skills.description: Plan and apply safe, incremental refactors that improve design without changing external behavior. Use when cleaning structure, reducing duplication, or preparing for a feature.

skills.name: release-notes
skills.description: Draft clear user-facing release notes from commits, PR titles, and issue labels. Use before tagging a release or writing a changelog blurb.

skills.name: security-audit
skills.description: Threat-model and audit code for OWASP-style issues, secrets, auth bugs, and unsafe defaults before merge or release.

skills.name: sql-review
skills.description: Review SQL for correctness, injection safety, indexes, and execution-plan hazards. Use when writing or reviewing queries and migrations.

skills.name: test-writer
skills.description: Design and write high-value unit and integration tests from code or requirements. Use when adding tests, improving coverage, or turning bugs into regressions.

essentials.description: Daily driver skills for most engineering repos
